news.title: Dotlines lands MYR 7M debt facility from OSK Ventures for Sohoj platform

recent_en: OSKVI released its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 on 24 November 2026 and announced the provision of financial assistance the same day; it had also announced financial assistance and an 'Others' item in October. In late August, OSK Ventures extended a MYR 7 million debt facility to Dotlines for its Sohoj platform.
notable_en: Announced results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 on 24 November 2026.
Announced provision of financial assistance on 24 November and 6 October 2026.
OSK Ventures extended a MYR 7 million debt facility to Dotlines for its Sohoj platform.
risks_en: Change of Company Secretary Ong Seow Wuen effective 1 September 2026.
Two 'Others' announcements on 1 October and 5 November with no specifics in the titles.
